## Anthropic SDK — Retry Behavior

When a request times out, the SDK automatically retries up to three times with exponential backoff. You can disable this with `max_retries=0`.

## Streaming Responses

Use `client.messages.stream()` to receive tokens incrementally. The stream context manager handles connection cleanup.

## Tool Use

Structured tool calls are returned in the `content` array with `type: "tool_use"`. Pass results back via a `tool_result` content block.

## Rate Limits

Tier-1 accounts are limited to 50k tokens/min. Contact support to upgrade.
